description: List GA4 properties under a given parent account. Returns full property records (display name, time zone, currency, industry, service level). Read-only.

accountId.description: Parent GA4 account ID, e.g. "123456" or "accounts/123456".

maxPages.description: Maximum number of API pages to fetch (default 50). If more pages remain, the result includes truncated:true and a nextPageToken.

pageToken.description: Continuation token to resume listing from a previous truncated result.

showDeleted.description: Include soft-deleted (trashed) properties in the results.

name: ga4_properties_list
